items.name: ComputeInverseInertia
items.plate_exact: INVENTED NAME, not canonical: no PS2 symbol found for this function. Named for what it does: computes the diagonal inverse inertia tensor of a rigid body from its mass (arg 2) and dimensions (args 3-5) into the three floats at arg 1 - cylinder formula (0.25/0.08333 terms) for one dimension <= 4.0, box formula (mass/3) otherwise. Called by PBondCar::PBondCar, PBondCar::ProcessPhysics and PBondCar::ChangeCarType. Was misnamed RSceneObj::Load (the real RSceneObj::Load is 0x90a60).
